instruction: I learned that there's an app where I can have floating window of note-taking sticker pads. Please help me open that app, and bring the instruction about customizing my notes to the front.
evaluator: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get value of attribute "AXChildren" of window 1 of (first application process whose frontmost is true)' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "It’s easy to customize your notes." && echo "True" || echo "False"
